title: Bee Removal in Kensington, Brooklyn
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Kensington, Brooklyn. Nest treatment, removal, and entry-point sealing. (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Best Pest Control NYC provides expert wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, carpenter bee, and ground bee removal services throughout Kensington, Brooklyn. Our licensed technicians identify the species, locate the nest, treat and remove it, and seal every entry point to prevent recolonization. If an inspection confirms the colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper.
whyUs: Our team has extensive experience handling bee infestations in Kensington's diverse mix of multi-family homes, pre-war buildings, and local businesses. We use safe, eco-friendly methods and offer same-day emergency service to quickly resolve bee problems before they escalate.
localContext: Kensington's tree-lined streets, proximity to Prospect Park, and abundance of older brick homes and apartment buildings create ideal conditions for wasp and hornet colonies to establish paper nests in wall voids, attics, eaves, and soffits. Yellow jackets often build ground nests in yards near the Parade Grounds, while carpenter bees bore galleries into wooden trim and fascia boards. The neighborhood's gardens and flowering trees attract stinging insects season after season, making professional nest removal and entry-point sealing essential for safe outdoor spaces.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in Kensington?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in Kensington?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: How quickly can you remove a wasp or hornet nest from my Kensington property?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day and emergency services throughout Kensington. Most wasp and hornet nest treatments are completed within 1–3 hours, though larger nests or hard-to-reach wall voids may require additional time for complete nest removal and entry-point sealing.

faqs.question: How do you approach treatments where children and pets live?
faqs.answer: We use EPA-registered products in targeted applications directly at the nest site. Before we begin, we explain the products used, the re-entry timing, and any precautions for children and pets during and after the treatment.
